description: This file contains the implementation of the PumpStream class, which provides a read-only stream that pumps data from a PHP callable, implementing the StreamInterface. It facilitates streaming data by repeatedly invoking a callable source until the requested amount of data is retrieved.

classes.name: PumpStream
classes.description: A read-only, pump-based stream class implementing the StreamInterface from PSR-7, sourcing its data via a user-provided callable.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the PumpStream with a callable source and optional stream options such as size and metadata.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the entire stream content as a string, or empty string if an exception occurs.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the stream by detaching the source.

methods.name: detach
methods.description: Detaches the source, resets positional and source data, signaling end of stream.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the stream if known.

methods.name: tell
methods.description: Returns the current read position in the stream.

methods.name: eof
methods.description: Checks if the stream has reached EOF by verifying if source is null.

methods.name: isSeekable
methods.description: Indicates that the stream does not support seeking.

methods.name: rewind
methods.description: Resets the stream position to the beginning (not supported, throws exception).

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Attempts to seek to a position in the stream (unsupported, throws exception).

methods.name: isWritable
methods.description: Returns false; the stream is read-only.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Throws exception; writing is not supported.

methods.name: isReadable
methods.description: Returns true; the stream is readable.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads specified number of bytes from the buffer, invoking the source as needed.

methods.name: getContents
methods.description: Reads and returns the entire remaining stream content.

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Returns stream metadata or specific key if provided.

methods.name: pump
methods.description: Internal method to invoke the callable source to fetch more data into the buffer until the required length is met.
